_about: The wording of FinCom's CA certificates (server/assistant/tools/certificates.ts). One file, edited by hand; every paragraph carries 'confirm': 'to confirm by the owner' until the owner has read and approved it (then change it to 'confirmed by the owner on <date>').
Placeholders are {{name}}. Never put a client's name, PAN, CIN, address or figure, or the firm's own details, in this file: they come from FinCom at run time.
Kinds of item: 'p' a paragraph (b bold, center, heading), 'table' one of the figure tables (turnover, networth, bvps), 'sign' the signature block, 'pb' a page break.

Order of preference when a certificate is made: the format uploaded for that job, then the firm's default (settings: 'icai' unless the owner chose 'firm', 'Use our usual format'), and with nothing chosen the ICAI format.
The UDIN is never filled by FinCom: {{udin}} is always printed as a blank line for the partner to write in after generating it on the UDIN portal.

placeholders.client_name: the entity's name as in the signed financial statements (else FinCom's client name)
placeholders.client_ids: CIN / LLPIN / PAN line, when known (blank otherwise)
placeholders.client_address: the registered office or principal place of business
placeholders.addressee: to whom the certificate is addressed (the bank, the tender authority, or 'The Board of Directors' / 'The Partners')
placeholders.purpose: the purpose the certificate is asked for (e.g. submission to <bank> for <facility>, tender no. ...)
placeholders.years_text: the financial years covered, e.g. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
placeholders.as_on: the date of the net worth, e.g. 31-03-2026
placeholders.auditor: who audited the financial statements, per year (typed by the user or read from the signed copy)
placeholders.basis_text: the basis of the figures: the signed (audited) financial statements, or the books where the user chose so for a year
placeholders.subject: Turnover / Net Worth / Turnover and Net Worth
placeholders.membership_no: the signing partner's ICAI membership no. (firm settings)
placeholders.place: the place of signing (firm settings, default)
placeholders.date: the date of the certificate (today unless the user gives another)
placeholders.udin: ALWAYS BLANK: a line for the partner to write the UDIN

turnover.p: 1. This certificate is issued in accordance with the terms of our engagement with {{client_name}} ("the {{client_kind_word}}"){{client_ids}}, having its registered office at {{client_address}}.

2. We have been requested by the Management of the {{client_kind_word}} to certify the turnover (Revenue from operations) of the {{client_kind_word}} for the financial years {{years_text}}, as stated in the Statement below ("the Statement"), for the purpose of {{purpose}}.

3. The preparation of the Statement is the responsibility of the Management of the {{client_kind_word}}, including the preparation and maintenance of all accounting and other relevant supporting records and documents. This responsibility includes the design, implementation and maintenance of internal control relevant to the preparation and presentation of the Statement and applying an appropriate basis of preparation, and making estimates that are reasonable in the circumstances.
4. Our responsibility is to provide reasonable assurance whether the turnover stated in the Statement is in agreement with {{basis_text}}. The financial statements were audited by {{auditor}}.

5. We conducted our examination of the Statement in accordance with the Guidance Note on Reports or Certificates for Special Purposes issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India ("ICAI"). The Guidance Note requires that we comply with the ethical requirements of the Code of Ethics issued by the ICAI.

6. We have complied with the relevant applicable requirements of the Standard on Quality Control (SQC) 1, Quality Control for Firms that Perform Audits and Reviews of Historical Financial Information, and Other Assurance and Related Services Engagements.
7. Based on our examination as above, and the information and explanations given to us, we certify that the turnover of the {{client_kind_word}} stated below is in agreement with {{basis_text}}:

8. This certificate is addressed to and provided to {{addressee}} solely for the purpose of {{purpose}} and should not be used by any other person or for any other purpose. Accordingly, we do not accept or assume any liability or any duty of care for any other purpose or to any other person to whom this certificate is shown or into whose hands it may come without our prior consent in writing.

networth.p: INDEPENDENT PRACTITIONER'S CERTIFICATE ON NET WORTH

To,
{{addressee}}
1. This certificate is issued in accordance with the terms of our engagement with {{client_name}} ("the {{client_kind_word}}"){{client_ids}}, having its registered office at {{client_address}}.

2. We have been requested by the Management of the {{client_kind_word}} to certify the net worth of the {{client_kind_word}} as on {{as_on}}, as worked out in the Statement below ("the Statement"), for the purpose of {{purpose}}.
Management's Responsibility

3. The preparation of the Statement is the responsibility of the Management of the {{client_kind_word}}, including the preparation and maintenance of all accounting and other relevant supporting records and documents. This responsibility includes the design, implementation and maintenance of internal control relevant to the preparation and presentation of the Statement and applying an appropriate basis of preparation, and making estimates that are reasonable in the circumstances.
Practitioner's Responsibility

4. Our responsibility is to provide reasonable assurance whether the figures in the Statement are in agreement with {{basis_text}} and whether the net worth has been worked out as described below. The financial statements were audited by {{auditor}}.

5. We conducted our examination of the Statement in accordance with the Guidance Note on Reports or Certificates for Special Purposes issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India ("ICAI"). The Guidance Note requires that we comply with the ethical requirements of the Code of Ethics issued by the ICAI.

6. We have complied with the relevant applicable requirements of the Standard on Quality Control (SQC) 1, Quality Control for Firms that Perform Audits and Reviews of Historical Financial Information, and Other Assurance and Related Services Engagements.
Opinion

7. Based on our examination as above, and the information and explanations given to us, we certify that the net worth of the {{client_kind_word}} as on {{as_on}}, worked out below from {{basis_text}}, is as follows. Net worth is taken as the aggregate of the paid-up share capital and all reserves created out of profits and securities premium, after deducting the aggregate value of the accumulated losses and deferred expenditure and miscellaneous expenditure not written off, and does not include reserves created out of revaluation of assets (section 2(57) of the Companies Act, 2013); for a firm or an LLP, the partners' capital and current accounts.
Restriction on Use

8. This certificate is addressed to and provided to {{addressee}} solely for the purpose of {{purpose}} and should not be used by any other person or for any other purpose. Accordingly, we do not accept or assume any liability or any duty of care for any other purpose or to any other person to whom this certificate is shown or into whose hands it may come without our prior consent in writing.
